name: Avalon International Breads
summary: Founded in 1997 by Ann Perrault and Jackie Victor, Avalon International Breads is a Detroit institution using 100% organic flour to produce artisan breads, pastries, and cafe fare. The bakery was established with an explicit social mission to support Detroit's revitalization and maintains an employee-centered culture. The Woodward Avenue location anchors the Midtown neighborhood and serves coffee, sandwiches, and baked goods daily. Wholesale bread is available by the baker's dozen.
